text:
A little extra pixie dust after dark ✨ #HollywoodStudios #WaltDisneyWorld
In the center of the reimagined courtyard at Disney's Hollywood Studios, a building inspired by the iconic Roy E. Disney Animation Building is home to The Magic of Disney Animation, a brand-new collection of experiences. 

Mickey’s iconic Sorcerer Hat sits on top of the building (just like the real building in California). If you visit after the sun goes down, take a moment to watch the Sorcerer Hat for moments of bright magic.

author: Disney Parks YouTube
text:
Carol has stepped up to the piano at Casey's Corner on Main Street, U.S.A. 🏰🎹 #DisneyWorld
Join us in welcoming Carol to Main Street, U.S.A. 🏰 Carol, a 36-year cast member, recently took her place behind the piano, bringing decades of musical experience and Disney storytelling to the heart of Main Street U.S.A. 

A native to Central Florida, Carol’s Disney story started back in 1990 at Pleasure Island’s Comedy Warehouse where she performed and entertained guests nightly with her craft.

Since then, Carol has played at venues around Walt Disney World including the Rose & Crown Pub and festivals at EPCOT, the Hoop-De-Doo Musical Revue at Disney’s Fort Wilderness Resort & Campground and notably, her favorite, the Grand Floridian Resort & Spa. And now, adding to her musical resume, she is playing those iconic ragtime classics at Casey’s Corner.
